title: Lu Xueqi's thunder
summary: Lu Xueqi beats Tian Ling'er, who was distracted by Qi Hao cheering her on, and goes into the top eight. Zhang Xiaofan comes back badly hurt but has beaten Peng Chang and is also in the top eight. Tian Buyi sees that Xiaofan's Taiji Xuanqing is at the fourth level, not the second, and suspects Ling'er of teaching him in secret. He and Su Ru argue about Ling'er, who has fallen for Qi Hao, a Dragon Head Peak disciple Tian Buyi can't stand; alone, Ling'er swears she and Qi Hao will be together forever. With Song Daren and Chang Jian badly injured, Xiaofan is the last Great Bamboo Peak disciple left, and he faces Lu Xueqi before he has recovered. Lu Xueqi calls down the Mighty Sword of Thunder despite a warning that it could backfire, and Xiaofan, expecting to die, wonders if Ling'er will remember him. Lu Xueqi wins. An elder then tells Dao Xuan that Xiaofan, only at Yuqing level 4 (Jade Purity), has a weapon that rivals Tianya and seems refined with blood, and that it does not belong to Qingyun.
